With experience across a wide spectrum of industries, Panduit's strategic network infrastructure and
industrial electrical wiring solutions turn connectivity into a competitive advantage.

### Ready to Talk?

We want to help you build the connections that move your business forward-- faster. From sales
questions to distributor connections and custom quotes, let's discuss how Panduit can help you make
connections that matter.

[ Speak to an Expert ][26]

**CUSTOMER CASE STUDIES**

### The Power of Partnertships: Your Success, Our Innovation

At Panduit, we believe your success is our success. Inspired by the spirit of ingenuity and a
passion for solving problems, we partner closely with customers to understand their unique
challenges. Explore how our innovative infrastructure and connectivity solutions have helped
companies like yours achieve their goals.

### Capilano University: A Blueprint for Connectivity

Outdated campus networks hindered CapU's mission. Panduit stepped in, transforming the tangled
infrastructure into a streamlined, color-coded system that improved connectivity for thousands.

[ Read More ][27]

### Miller Electric Powers Up with Panduit's FMPS

Miller Electric faced complex power distribution challenges. Panduit's innovative Fault Managed
Power System (FMPS) delivered the solution, helping Miller Electric realize significant cost
savings.

[ Read More ][28]

### Rockford Public Schools Modernizes its Data Center

Facing an outdated network, security vulnerabilities, and limited capacity, Rockford Public Schools
partnered with Panduit to modernize its data center. This partnership resulted in a robust, secure
infrastructure that connects over 27,000 students and staff.

Warehouses are automated, buildings are smart, data centers are increasingly complex, and just about
everything can be controlled by the devices in our hands. Panduit has everything you need to make
digital transformation efficient and effective.

[ Explore Digital Transformation ][10] [ Speak to an Expert ][11]
[Industrial rooftop solar panels at sunset view]

### Electrification

Build your business stronger with electrification. This strategic investment is your key to a
sustainable future and reduced operational costs.

[ Explore Electrification ][12] [ Speak to an Expert ][13]

Sustainability isn't just a goal-- it's how we build better. Create more environmentally responsible
infrastructure with our broad portfolio of electrical and data solutions.

infrastructure that powers workforce transformation at every level. Discover how we’re helping
businesses adapt, automate, and thrive.

# Group chat that’s all fun & games

Discord is great for playing games and chilling with friends, or even building a worldwide
community. Customize your own space to talk, play, and hang out.

[Group chat that’s all fun & games]
[
Download for Windows
][90][Open Discord in your browser][91]

## find your friends on discord.

[Download][92]
[Make your group chats more fun]

## MAKE YOUR GROUP CHATS MORE FUN

Use custom emoji, stickers, soundboard effects and more to add your personality to your voice,
video, or text chat. Set your avatar and a custom status, and write your own profile to show up in
chat your way.

## stream like you’re in the same room

High quality and low latency streaming makes it feel like you're hanging out on the couch with
friends while playing a game, watching shows, looking at photos, or idk doing homework or something.

[stream like you’re in the same room]
[Hop in when you're free, no need to call]

## Hop in when you're free, no need to call

Easily hop in and out of voice or text chats without having to call or invite anyone, so your party
chat lasts before, during, and after your game session.

## See who's around to chill

See who's around, playing games, or just hanging out. For supported games, you can see what modes or

[See who's around to chill]
[always have something to do together]

## always have something to do together

Watch videos, play built-in games, listen to music, or just scroll together and spam memes.
Seamlessly text, call, video chat, and play games, all in one group chat.

## wherever YOU GAME, HANG OUT HERE

On your PC, phone, or console, you can still hang out on Discord. Easily switch between devices and
use tools to manage multiple group chats with friends.

[wherever YOU GAME, HANG OUT HERE]

industrial, automotive, commercial, agricultural, and petroleum sectors nationwide. With over 45

## LED Retrofit Kits and Engines

#### Retrofitting Made Easy

Retrofitting existing non-LED fixtures to efficient LED technology has never been easier. The Fulham
LED retrofit line features field-installable AC Direct Drive and DC LED engine kits in various
shapes, LED light power levels (at different lumens / wattage), dimming options, and color
temperatures (including CCT-selectable models). DLC® kits are available. Fulham has recently added
LED retrofits for 2×2 and 2×4 troffers and panels, too!

[Explore LED Retrofit Kits & Engines][84]

## Emergency LED Drivers, Inverters, and EXIT Signs & Lights

Fulham has set the industry standard for LED emergency lighting solutions which bring powerful,
reliable backup lighting to nearly any egress situation. When trouble strikes, people don’t want to
think about lighting technology – they just want to see well enough to get to safety. Fulham has
developed hundreds of dependable lighting systems, many of which are innovative, first-of-their-kind
Emergency LED solutions.

[Explore Emergency and Exit Solutions][85]

## Fulham Provides Essential Solutions

Fulham pictures a world in which society can benefit from everything the latest technology makes
possible – health, safety, energy efficiency and convenience. Decades of experience puts Fulham at
the forefront of innovative technology in ESSENTIAL lighting products with emphasis on these
applications:

## LED Retrofit Kits and Engines

#### Retrofitting Made Easy

Retrofitting existing non-LED fixtures to efficient LED technology has never been easier. The Fulham
LED retrofit line features field-installable AC Direct Drive and DC LED engine kits in various
shapes, LED light power levels (at different lumens / wattage), dimming options, and color
temperatures (including CCT-selectable models). DLC® kits are available. Fulham has recently added
LED retrofits for 2×2 and 2×4 troffers and panels, too!

[Explore LED Retrofit Kits & Engines][84]

## Emergency LED Drivers, Inverters, and EXIT Signs & Lights

Fulham has set the industry standard for LED emergency lighting solutions which bring powerful,
reliable backup lighting to nearly any egress situation. When trouble strikes, people don’t want to
think about lighting technology – they just want to see well enough to get to safety. Fulham has
developed hundreds of dependable lighting systems, many of which are innovative, first-of-their-kind
Emergency LED solutions.

[Explore Emergency and Exit Solutions][85]

## Versatile Items Save Time & Money

#### Fewer SKUs needed via Programmability & Selectivity

From inception, Fulham has developed several of its core product programs with multi-purpose
functionality for convenience, SKU-reduction, ordering ease, storage space reduction, cost savings
and quick installation in mind. Explore below for several items that allow you to accomplish the
most with the fewest number of items.

[Programmable LED Drivers][86][Programmable Emergency Solutions][87][CCT-Selectable Retrofit
Kits][88][Micro-Inverters][89][WorkHorse Ballasts][90]

## Uncommonly Robust Engineering Capabilities

Fulham is not merely an importer, multi-lister and reseller. Our in-house Engineering Team is the
point of origin for our innovations. Fulham develops items for general release around the world,
plus items unique to customer requirements. We’ve been doing this for decades both quickly and
competitively. Learn more below:

[Customizations][91][Rapid Development][92][Quick Turn Samples][93][Competitive Manufacturing][94]

# Your Expert Source for
# Performance Driven Environmental Equipment & Supplies.

For more than 45 years, Geotech has manufactured and distributed the equipment environmental
professionals depend on, from groundwater sampling pumps to telemetry systems, water quality
instruments to XRF analyzers.

### Manufacturing

### Distribution

Serving the environmental industry high-quality equipment since 1978.

### [Rentals & Repairs][120]

real-world application presentations.

[Explore Field Days][128]

[Geotech engineering and machining]

FOUNDED ON INNOVATION

For more than four decades, Geotech has been a leader in the environmental industry. Our commitment
to innovation began in 1978 with the development of the [Geopump Peristaltic Pump][129] which
quickly became industry standard.

### Hose Reel Supplier Directory Overview

Find, compare, and connect with hose reel manufacturers that supply hose reels, industrial hose
reels, air hose reels, water hose reels, high pressure hose reels, extension cord reels, cable
reels, fire hose reels, and unique hose reels for demanding applications. This supplier directory
helps buyers browse reel options for manufacturing, construction, automotive service, aviation,
healthcare, welding, agriculture, landscaping, and facility maintenance. Source reels by hose
length, pressure rating, mounting style, rewind method, material, and intended environment, then
compare suppliers that can support standard products, custom configurations, accessories,
replacement parts, and application-specific hose management needs.

### Industrial Hose Reel Applications

Industrial hose reels store and manage hoses used for air, water, oil, grease, fuel, chemicals, and
other service media in plants, shops, maintenance bays, and mobile work areas. These reels help
manufacturing, construction, mining, fleet maintenance, and processing facilities keep hoses
organized, protected from abrasion, and ready for controlled extension and retraction during daily
operations.

### Air Hose Reels in Manufacturing and Automotive Use

Air hose reels, also called pneumatic hose reels, support compressed-air delivery for tools,
assembly stations, garages, service trucks, and production lines. Automotive repair, fabrication,
packaging, woodworking, and general manufacturing operations use these reels to reduce hose clutter,
improve reach, and keep pneumatic lines from creating floor hazards in active work zones.

### Water, High Pressure, and Washdown Hose Reels

Water hose reels and high pressure hose reels are built for washdown, pressure washing, irrigation,
sanitation, fire protection, and fluid transfer applications. Food processing, agriculture,
landscaping, municipal maintenance, marine service, and industrial cleaning operations use these
reels when hose capacity, corrosion resistance, pressure handling, and quick deployment matter.

### Extension Cord, Cable, and Power Management Reels

Extension cord reels, cable reels, and industrial reels organize power cords, electrical cable,
grounding cable, welding leads, and specialty lines used in construction, warehousing, staging,
robotics, machining, and equipment maintenance. Buyers may compare manual, spring-powered,
motorized, portable, wall-mounted, ceiling-mounted, and truck-mounted options depending on available
space, duty cycle, and operator access.

### Industry Applications for Hose Reels

Manufacturing facilities need industrial hose reels that support compressed air, coolant, lubricant,
and washdown lines near machinery and assembly stations. Construction crews rely on portable hose
reels, extension cord reels, and heavy-duty industrial reels that move across changing job sites.
Automotive and fleet service shops require air hose reels, exhaust hose reels, and oil or grease
reels for repair bays. Healthcare facilities use cord reels and sanitary reel materials to manage
mobile equipment safely. Agriculture, landscaping, and municipal operations often source water hose
reels, 100 foot hose reel options, and corrosion-resistant reels for outdoor use.

### Sizing and Duty Cycle Considerations

Start by matching the reel to production volume, hose frequency, and throughput. A low-use
maintenance area may only need a manual reel, while a busy plant, service bay, or washdown station
may require spring-powered or motorized retraction to reduce labor and speed up repeated hose
handling.

### Process Media and Compatibility

Process type also matters. Air, water, fuel, oil, chemicals, steam, hydraulic fluid, and electrical
cable each place different demands on seals, swivel joints, hose compatibility, pressure rating,
grounding, and reel construction. Buyers should compare hose reel manufacturers by their experience
with the specific medium and operating environment.

### Integration and Installation Fit

Integration with existing lines should be reviewed before purchase. Mounting location, ceiling
clearance, floor space, hose travel path, connector type, hose diameter, and reach all affect
whether a reel fits cleanly into an existing production cell, service area, truck bed, or facility
layout.

### Inspection, Certification, and Safety Standards

Inspection and certification requirements may apply in fire protection, healthcare, hazardous
locations, food processing, compressed-air systems, and industrial safety programs. Buyers should
ask suppliers about pressure testing, material documentation, applicable safety standards, grounding
requirements, corrosion resistance, and replacement-part availability.

### Custom and Specialty Hose Reel Selection

Supplier specialization is important when comparing standard and custom hose reel options. A strong
supplier should understand reel diameter, hose length, rewind method, duty cycle, mounting
orientation, environmental exposure, and accessory needs such as ball stops, roller guides, bumpers,
brackets, and rewind motors.

### FAQ

#### How do I find hose reel manufacturers for industrial applications?

Start by defining the hose type, medium, pressure rating, length, mounting location, and rewind
style needed for the application. Then compare hose reel manufacturers that serve your industry and
can support the required material, capacity, and safety features. A directory makes it easier to
browse suppliers by product type and connect with companies that match your operating conditions.

#### What type of industrial hose reel should I choose for a busy production area?

High-use areas usually benefit from spring-powered or motorized industrial hose reels because they
reduce manual winding and keep hoses off the floor between uses. Look at duty cycle, hose weight,
reach, and operator access before selecting a reel. For harsh environments, compare
corrosion-resistant materials, sealed components, and protective finishes.

#### When does a buyer need a 100 foot hose reel?

A 100 foot hose reel is useful when operators need longer reach without moving the reel or dragging
loose hose across the work area. These reels are common in washdown, landscaping, agriculture,
service bays, and large maintenance zones. Buyers should confirm hose diameter, pressure rating,
rewind strength, and mounting stability before choosing this length.

#### What is the difference between an air hose reel and an extension cord reel?

An air hose reel stores and delivers compressed air for pneumatic tools, blowoff stations, and shop
equipment. An extension cord reel stores electrical cord for power distribution, tools, lighting, or
mobile equipment. Both improve organization and safety, but they require different construction,
ratings, connectors, and inspection considerations.

#### How should I compare custom or unique hose reels?

Custom and unique hose reels should be evaluated by application fit rather than appearance alone.
Review hose capacity, material compatibility, mounting orientation, retraction method, environmental
exposure, and accessory options. Ask whether the supplier can modify fittings, finishes, brackets,
drum size, hose length, or guides to match the application.

may require spring-powered or motorized retraction to reduce labor and speed up repeated hose
handling.

### Process Media and Compatibility

Process type also matters. Air, water, fuel, oil, chemicals, steam, hydraulic fluid, and electrical
cable each place different demands on seals, swivel joints, hose compatibility, pressure rating,
grounding, and reel construction. Buyers should compare hose reel manufacturers by their experience
with the specific medium and operating environment.

### Integration and Installation Fit

Integration with existing lines should be reviewed before purchase. Mounting location, ceiling
clearance, floor space, hose travel path, connector type, hose diameter, and reach all affect
whether a reel fits cleanly into an existing production cell, service area, truck bed, or facility
layout.

### Inspection, Certification, and Safety Standards

Inspection and certification requirements may apply in fire protection, healthcare, hazardous
locations, food processing, compressed-air systems, and industrial safety programs. Buyers should
ask suppliers about pressure testing, material documentation, applicable safety standards, grounding
requirements, corrosion resistance, and replacement-part availability.

### Custom and Specialty Hose Reel Selection

Supplier specialization is important when comparing standard and custom hose reel options. A strong
supplier should understand reel diameter, hose length, rewind method, duty cycle, mounting
orientation, environmental exposure, and accessory needs such as ball stops, roller guides, bumpers,
brackets, and rewind motors.

### FAQ

#### How do I find hose reel manufacturers for industrial applications?

Start by defining the hose type, medium, pressure rating, length, mounting location, and rewind
style needed for the application. Then compare hose reel manufacturers that serve your industry and
can support the required material, capacity, and safety features. A directory makes it easier to
browse suppliers by product type and connect with companies that match your operating conditions.

#### What type of industrial hose reel should I choose for a busy production area?

High-use areas usually benefit from spring-powered or motorized industrial hose reels because they
reduce manual winding and keep hoses off the floor between uses. Look at duty cycle, hose weight,
reach, and operator access before selecting a reel. For harsh environments, compare
corrosion-resistant materials, sealed components, and protective finishes.

#### When does a buyer need a 100 foot hose reel?

A 100 foot hose reel is useful when operators need longer reach without moving the reel or dragging
loose hose across the work area. These reels are common in washdown, landscaping, agriculture,
service bays, and large maintenance zones. Buyers should confirm hose diameter, pressure rating,
rewind strength, and mounting stability before choosing this length.

#### What is the difference between an air hose reel and an extension cord reel?

An air hose reel stores and delivers compressed air for pneumatic tools, blowoff stations, and shop
equipment. An extension cord reel stores electrical cord for power distribution, tools, lighting, or
mobile equipment. Both improve organization and safety, but they require different construction,
ratings, connectors, and inspection considerations.

#### How should I compare custom or unique hose reels?

Custom and unique hose reels should be evaluated by application fit rather than appearance alone.
Review hose capacity, material compatibility, mounting orientation, retraction method, environmental
exposure, and accessory options. Ask whether the supplier can modify fittings, finishes, brackets,
drum size, hose length, or guides to match the application.

][53] [
Лукойл. МЛСП им. Ю. Корчагина
Нефтегазовая промышленность
Специалистами компании ЛЕО ТЕЛЕКОМ была запроектирована система связи, удовлетворяющая всем
вышеуказанным требованиям. Произведена поставка оборудования, монтаж, пуско-наладочные работы и ввод
в эксплуатацию системы профессиональной цифровой транкинговой радиосвязи на базе оборудования
Kenwood Nexedge. Произведена сертификация взрывобезопасного абонентского оборудования.
Распределенная система АФУ покрывает все зоны платформы, включая внутренние, труднодоступные для
проникновения радиосигнала, помещения.
][54] [
Авианосец "Адмирал Горшков" - "Викрамадитья"
Морской флот
Система бортовой связи стандарта NXDN на базе оборудования Kenwood Nexedge была разработана и
внедрена специалистами ЗАО «ЛЕО ТЕЛЕКОМ» совместно со специалистами ОАО «Муромский радиозавод».
Установлены 8 цифровых ретрансляторов, система записи переговоров, произведена интеграция с бортовой
системой громкоговорящей связи и оповещения. Разработан абонентский комплект, состоящий из цифровой
радиостанции, спецчехла и шумозащищенной гарнитуры.
][55]

# The Source For All Of Your Rubber Product Needs

Manufacturer’s Rubber and Supply is your source for all of your rubber supply needs. No matter what
industry you work in, or what project you are looking to complete, if you need industrial rubber
products, you have come to the right place. From bulk rubber gaskets to O-rings to grommets, you can
find everything you are looking for here.

Some of our most popular selling items include gaskets, grommets, O-rings, and our own joint
sealant.  Our extensive inventory includes a wide selection of metal O-rings, natural O-rings,
fluorosilicone O-Rings and more. Gaskets are manufactured for a variety of applications and our
selection includes hand-cut Gaskets, felt Gaskets, die-cut Gaskets, and cloth-inserted Gaskets. For
Grommet and Grommet Bumper needs, our selection includes multiple hole Grommets, horseshoe Grommets,
and mounting hole Grommets. Joint sealant from Manufacturer’s Rubber and Supply is called the MRS –
Seal which is an expanded PTFE joint sealant. This product is ideal for several sealing applications
such as pump and compressor housing flanges, heat exchangers, and irregular flanges. With our
competitive pricing, years of experience, and our outstanding customer service, we are happy to help
you find a solution to your problem. Get started on your order by [requesting a quote][87] today.

## Introducing A Motorized Aluminum
## Reel That’s Ready When You Are^{®}

Our **NEW** Series 20000 motorized aluminum hose reel is here! This versatile, lightweight reel will
revolutionize your work day, whether you’re on the go or at home. Great for spray, pressure wash,
chemical application, garden use, and more.

[LEARN MORE][70]
[BUY NOW][71]

## Our reels are found everywhere people work and build

Reelcraft manufactures the widest range of hose, cord, and cable reels. We’re known for our quality,
which is built into every component of every reel.

It’s no wonder companies and hardworking people around the world have come to rely on Reelcraft
reels to get the job done. For over fifty years, we’ve worked to make our reels stronger, more
reliable, more durable, and easier to use. Our reels make work safer and easier—and that’s something
we’re pretty proud of.

[Read more][72]

## The Reelcraft Commitment

The team at Reelcraft is on a mission to make the world safer, healthier, and more productive. We
strive to provide the quality, delivery, and value that will satisfy our customers.

Reelcraft’s Quality Management System has been ISO 9001 accredited since 1996 and is ISO 9001:2015
certified by Intertek.

We manufacture the widest range of hose, cord, and cable reels used in a wide variety of
applications.

Quality is built into the processes of our entire organization, in the design, manufacture, and
assembly of our reels.

Reelcraft has proven itself as a highly innovative company in developing new products for a wide
range of markets.

## Designed, Built, and Tested to be Ready When You Are^{®}

We spend months designing a reel. We build entire manufacturing processes around that design. And
then we test it to its limit. This is why we are the industry standard for reels.

We design and engineer each reel to meet customer needs and make work safer and easier.

Everything we do in manufacturing revolves around making our reels: stronger, lighter, and more
durable. 

No matter the job, you can count on Reelcraft to put in the work. Our reels don’t break, tire, or
wear out the way other reels do. They’re there for you from clock-in to job done. They’re designed,
built, and tested to be Ready When You Are^{®}

## Introducing A Motorized Aluminum
## Reel That’s Ready When You Are^{®}

Our **NEW** Series 20000 motorized aluminum hose reel is here! This versatile, lightweight reel will
revolutionize your work day, whether you’re on the go or at home. Great for spray, pressure wash,
chemical application, garden use, and more.

[LEARN MORE][70]
[BUY NOW][71]

## Our reels are found everywhere people work and build

Reelcraft manufactures the widest range of hose, cord, and cable reels. We’re known for our quality,
which is built into every component of every reel.

It’s no wonder companies and hardworking people around the world have come to rely on Reelcraft
reels to get the job done. For over fifty years, we’ve worked to make our reels stronger, more
reliable, more durable, and easier to use. Our reels make work safer and easier—and that’s something
we’re pretty proud of.

[Read more][72]

## The Reelcraft Commitment

The team at Reelcraft is on a mission to make the world safer, healthier, and more productive. We
strive to provide the quality, delivery, and value that will satisfy our customers.

Reelcraft’s Quality Management System has been ISO 9001 accredited since 1996 and is ISO 9001:2015
certified by Intertek.

We manufacture the widest range of hose, cord, and cable reels used in a wide variety of
applications.

Quality is built into the processes of our entire organization, in the design, manufacture, and
assembly of our reels.

Reelcraft has proven itself as a highly innovative company in developing new products for a wide
range of markets.

## Designed, Built, and Tested to be Ready When You Are^{®}

We spend months designing a reel. We build entire manufacturing processes around that design. And
then we test it to its limit. This is why we are the industry standard for reels.

We design and engineer each reel to meet customer needs and make work safer and easier.

Everything we do in manufacturing revolves around making our reels: stronger, lighter, and more
durable. 

No matter the job, you can count on Reelcraft to put in the work. Our reels don’t break, tire, or
wear out the way other reels do. They’re there for you from clock-in to job done. They’re designed,
built, and tested to be Ready When You Are^{®}.

* July 22, 2026
* Reel Power

##### [Reel Power Marine & Energy Celebrates Five-Year Safety Milestone with More Than 1,800 Days
##### Without a Lost Time Accident][130]

**Houston, TX – [July 22, 2026]** – Reel Power Marine & Energy, a leading provider of engineered
solutions for offshore, subsea, U.S. land-based energy, and defense applications, proudly announces
a significant safety achievement: **more than five consecutive years and over 1,800 days without a
Lost Time Accident (LTA)**.

This milestone surpasses the company’s previous safety record of 1,003 consecutive days and
represents one of the most significant achievements in Reel Power Marine & Energy’s history. It
reflects the company’s unwavering commitment to protecting its employees, maintaining operational
excellence, and delivering reliable equipment for the world’s most demanding environments.

[Read more about Reel Power Marine & Energy Celebrates Five-Year Safety Milestone with More Than
1,800 Days Without a Lost Time Accident][131]
[Reel Power Marine & Energy Appoints Guillermo Calderon as Director of Business Development for
Marine Services]
* April 24, 2026
* Reel Power

##### [Reel Power Marine & Energy Appoints Guillermo Calderon as Director of Business Development
##### for Marine Services][132]

**Houston, TX – [April 24, 2026] – Reel Power Marine & Energy**, a leading provider of advanced
marine and energy solutions, is pleased to announce the appointment of **Guillermo Calderon** as its
new **Director of Business Development for Marine Services**.

Guillermo has been a business development leader in the marine and offshore market for 19+ years
with experience across the Americas, Europe, Latin America and Asia. He holds an M.S. in Industrial
Engineering and a B.S. in Mechanical Engineering from Universidad de Los Andes, Colombia, as well as
a Postgraduate Diploma in Strategy and Innovation and an Executive MBA from Saïd Business School,
University of Oxford.

[Read more about Reel Power Marine & Energy Appoints Guillermo Calderon as Director of Business
Development for Marine Services][133]

##### [StoneTree Makes Strategic Equity Investment in Reel Power International][134]

Oklahoma City – December 3, 2025 – StoneTree Investment Partners (“StoneTree”), a Dallas-based
private equity firm, announced its recent investment in **Reel Power International (“Reel Power”)**,
a leading manufacturer of capital equipment for material handling and controls serving industrial,
marine, and energy markets.

[Read more about StoneTree Makes Strategic Equity Investment in Reel Power International][135]

Reel Power Marine & Energy, a leader in engineered handling solutions, has successfully designed and

a Lost Time Accident]
* July 22, 2026
* Reel Power

##### [Reel Power Marine & Energy Celebrates Five-Year Safety Milestone with More Than 1,800 Days
##### Without a Lost Time Accident][130]

**Houston, TX – [July 22, 2026]** – Reel Power Marine & Energy, a leading provider of engineered
solutions for offshore, subsea, U.S. land-based energy, and defense applications, proudly announces
a significant safety achievement: **more than five consecutive years and over 1,800 days without a
Lost Time Accident (LTA)**.

This milestone surpasses the company’s previous safety record of 1,003 consecutive days and
represents one of the most significant achievements in Reel Power Marine & Energy’s history. It
reflects the company’s unwavering commitment to protecting its employees, maintaining operational
excellence, and delivering reliable equipment for the world’s most demanding environments.

[Read more about Reel Power Marine & Energy Celebrates Five-Year Safety Milestone with More Than
1,800 Days Without a Lost Time Accident][131]
[Reel Power Marine & Energy Appoints Guillermo Calderon as Director of Business Development for
Marine Services]
* April 24, 2026
* Reel Power

##### [Reel Power Marine & Energy Appoints Guillermo Calderon as Director of Business Development
##### for Marine Services][132]

**Houston, TX – [April 24, 2026] – Reel Power Marine & Energy**, a leading provider of advanced
marine and energy solutions, is pleased to announce the appointment of **Guillermo Calderon** as its
new **Director of Business Development for Marine Services**.

Guillermo has been a business development leader in the marine and offshore market for 19+ years
with experience across the Americas, Europe, Latin America and Asia. He holds an M.S. in Industrial
Engineering and a B.S. in Mechanical Engineering from Universidad de Los Andes, Colombia, as well as
a Postgraduate Diploma in Strategy and Innovation and an Executive MBA from Saïd Business School,
University of Oxford.

[Read more about Reel Power Marine & Energy Appoints Guillermo Calderon as Director of Business
Development for Marine Services][133]

a leading manufacturer of capital equipment for material handling and controls serving industrial,
marine, and energy markets.

## Milestones that define our journey

Institutional recognition, landmark legal outcomes, and industry honours that affirm CORD's place at
the forefront of dispute resolution in India.

[
Incubation

### CORD Incubated at IIM Bangalore

CORD was selected for incubation at the Indian Institute of Management Bangalore — a recognition of
CORD's potential to transform dispute resolution at scale across India.

][27][
Award

### CORD Wins the JUST AI Award

CORD was recognised with the JUST AI Award for responsible and ethical use of artificial
intelligence in legal dispute resolution — a first-of-its-kind honour in India's ODR space.

][28][
Regulatory

### Selected for SEBI's SmartODR Framework

CORD was onboarded to provide online conciliation and arbitration services for securities market
disputes at NSE and NCDEX — a landmark regulatory recognition from India's capital markets
regulator.

][29][
Legal Milestone

### CORD Arbitral Award Upheld by the Courts

In a landmark development, an arbitral award issued through CORD's platform was upheld by the
courts, affirming the enforceability and legal standing of online arbitration proceedings
administered by CORD.

][30]

Case Spotlight

22 Jul 2026

### Manash Kamal Bezboruah v. Bokahola Tea Company Private Limited & Ors. (SCI- 2026)

The Supreme Court held that the High Court's Article 227 jurisdiction cannot be invoked against an
Arbitral Tribunal's Section 16 order absent a patent lack of inherent jurisdiction — the remedy lies
in Section 34, post-award.

Article

### Digital Access as a Fundamental Right, and the Promise of ODR

When essential services move online, accessibility is not a courtesy — it is a constitutional
guarantee. At CORD, this principle is the ground we stand on.

Read →
][40][
Case Spotlight

19 Jun 2026

### Amit Chaurasia v. ICICI Bank Ltd. (2026-BomHC)

When parties agree to ODR in their contract, that agreement binds them — including the appointment
process. The Bombay High Court declined to interfere, finding that consent given at contracting
cannot be walked back at enforcement.

Read →
][41]

  ## Overview
  
  Torrent Electricals has been a trusted cable manufacturer for over 30 years. Backed by Torrent
  Power's expertise, we ensure superior quality and innovation. As India's first ISO 9001:2000
  certified manufacturer, we set industry benchmarks.
  
  [Company Overview]
  
  ## Torrent Group
  
  Torrent Group, founded in 1959, drives innovation in healthcare and power. Focused on
  pharmaceuticals, energy, and sustainability, it pioneers transformative solutions. Committed to
  excellence, Torrent shapes a smarter future.
  
  [Torrent Group]
  
  ## Core Values
  
  Torrent Group's core values of integrity, excellence, and transparency drive success. We foster a
  culture of accountability, inclusivity, and sustainability, ensuring growth. Committed to fairness
  and responsibility, we create lasting value.
  
  [Core Values]
  
  ## Leadership
  
  Torrent Electricals is led by an experienced Chairman and Board of Directors who bring strategic
  vision, strong governance, and industry expertise. Their leadership drives innovation, operational
  excellence, and long term value creation for the organization.
  
  [Leadership]
  
  ## Exports
  
  Torrent Electricals delivers high-quality cable solutions worldwide. With advanced manufacturing,
  we serve the USA, Australia, UK, and UAE. Our solutions cater to power utilities, solar companies,
  and industries.
  
  [Exports]
  
  ## QA & Certifications
  
  Torrent Electricals has been with the Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) for 60 years. With advanced
  facilities, we ensure excellence. Our commitment to innovation makes us trusted and reliable.
  
  [QA and Certifications]
  
  ## Turnkey Solutions
  
  Torrent Electricals delivers turnkey solutions up to 132KV for industries, utilities, and
  renewable energy. With expertise in project execution, we ensure seamless power solutions.
  
  [Turnkey Solutions]
  
  ## Cable Designs
  
  Torrent Electricals' Design Department delivers high-quality cable solutions. With 30+ years of
  expertise, we ensure reliability in EHV, HT, and LT design. Our support includes AutoCAD drawings
  and custom solutions.
  
  [Cable Designs]
  
  ## Manufacturing & R&D Capabilities
  
  Advanced engineering, precision manufacturing, and innovative R&D coming together to deliver
  high-quality, reliable, and future-ready electrical solutions.
  
  [Manufacturing and R&D]

Backed by Torrent Power's expertise, we ensure superior quality and innovation. As India's first ISO 9001:2000 certified manufacturer, we set industry benchmarks. [Company Overview] ## Torrent Group Torrent Group, founded in 1959, drives innovation in healthcare and power. Focused on pharmaceuticals, energy, and sustainability, it pioneers transformative solutions. Committed to excellence, Torrent shapes a smarter future. [Torrent Group] ## Core Values Torrent Group's core values of integrity, excellence, and transparency drive success. We foster a culture of accountability, inclusivity, and sustainability, ensuring growth. Committed to fairness and responsibility, we create lasting value. [Core Values] ## Leadership Torrent Electricals is led by an experienced Chairman and Board of Directors who bring strategic vision, strong governance, and industry expertise. Their leadership drives innovation, operational excellence, and long term value creation for the organization. [Leadership] ## Exports Torrent Electricals delivers high-quality cable solutions worldwide. With advanced manufacturing, we serve the USA, Australia, UK, and UAE. Our solutions cater to power utilities, solar companies, and industries. [Exports] ## QA & Certifications Torrent Electricals has been with the Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) for 60 years. With advanced facilities, we ensure excellence. Our commitment to innovation makes us trusted and reliable. [QA and Certifications] ## Turnkey Solutions Torrent Electricals delivers turnkey solutions up to 132KV for industries, utilities, and renewable energy. With expertise in project execution, we ensure seamless power solutions. [Turnkey Solutions] ## Cable Designs Torrent Electricals' Design Department delivers high-quality cable solutions. With 30+ years of expertise, we ensure reliability in EHV, HT, and LT design. Our support includes AutoCAD drawings and custom solutions. [Cable Designs] ## Manufacturing & R&D Capabilities Advanced engineering, precision manufacturing, and innovative R&D coming together to deliver high-quality, reliable, and future-ready electrical solutions. With this philosophy of Founder Chairman Mr. U. N. Mehta, Torrent makes continuous efforts through its CSR activities to give back to the society, for all the care, healing, support and nurturance being bestowed upon us. [Our Philosophy] ## Community Healthcare Torrent Group advances community healthcare through hospitals, pediatric programs, and interventions. From U.N. Mehta Institute to UNM Children's Hospital, we provide life-saving care and ensure a healthier future. [Community Healthcare] ## Education & Knowledge Enhancement Empowering 15,000+ children across 40+ villages with schools, infrastructure, and academic support. [Education & Knowledge Enhancement] ## Art, Culture and Wellbeing Showcasing visual arts, theatre, dance, and music, with 300+ artists and an audience of 2.6+ lakh over five editions. [Art, Culture and Wellbeing] ## Ecology Restoring 15 gardens, 2 lakes, and Shetrunjay Hills, with 56+ lakh annual visitors, creating sustainable green spaces.
